mechanism: Galantamine (cholinesterase inhibitor) enhances cholinergic effects while chlorpromazine has anticholinergic properties, creating opposing pharmacodynamic effects; both drugs also lower seizure threshold and can cause CNS depression.
action: Monitor for reduced galantamine efficacy and increased chlorpromazine anticholinergic effects; consider alternative antipsychotic with less anticholinergic activity if cognitively-impaired patient requires both agents.
